content.title: Jeff Bezos reportedly returns to the trenches as co-CEO of new AI startup, Project Prometheus
content.summary: Jeff Bezos is partly backing a new AI startup called Project Prometheus that has raised $6.2 billion in funding, and will take on duties as co-chief executive.

content.title: Jeff Bezos to co-lead AI startup in first operational role since Amazon, NYT reports
content.summary: The company, ‌called Project Prometheus, has garnered $6.2 billion in funding, partly from the Amazon founder, making it one of the most well-financed early-stage startups in the world, the report said, ⁠citing three people familiar ‌with the company.  This is the first time Bezos has taken a formal operational role in a company ‍since he stepped down as the CEO of Amazon in July 2021.  With the new startup, Bezos is entering ‌a crowded AI market with several smaller firms attempting to break through with new software and products while in a race with industry mainstays such as the Microsoft-backed OpenAI, Meta and Google.
